subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes, including storage boundary, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause/session/user propagation?
rationale: The security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, and whether this belongs in memory-core, a plugin SDK persistence seam, or an external bundle; current code only has lifecycle events and related PRs do not settle those choices.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify storage, integrity, redaction, and event schema before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader provenance hooks
options.body: Track implementation behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48509 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48519 if maintainers want one persistence architecture for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: Externalize to plugin or MCP
options.body: Close or narrow core work only if maintainers decide existing plugin/MCP surfaces are sufficient for memory-audit packages without new core contracts.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify storage, integrity, redaction, and event schema before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this as memory/security design and has recent history on memory flush, memory docs, and the current memory event surfaces.
